kv_fusion: concatenate K and V to 1024 dimensions before input projection
temporal_processing: independent causal sequence for each Qwen layer and patch
positive_target: RMS(delta_K, delta_V) over the 512-dimensional KV feature
inference_layer_fusion: mean or max over 28 Qwen layers
